relevance_rank_note: Isogenic APOE3/APOE4 human iPSC astrocytes; measures transferrin uptake and endosome marker levels (incl. RAB11 recycling endosomes) but never receptor surface level or a recycling rate, so all genotype findings are class 3 surrogates.

description: Flow cytometry of fluorescent transferrin internalized over 5 min showed lower transferrin uptake in APOE4 than APOE3 iPSC astrocytes in serum-free medium, across two isogenic line pairs.
quote: We observed a decreased uptake of the fluorescently labeled transferrin ligand (Figure 2B, 2D, and S2A, S2B) as well as decreased levels of EEA1 (early endosomal antigen 1)-positive early endosomes
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less transferrin uptake, a TfR-dependent surrogate for receptor available at the surface)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, two isogenic sets (KOLF2.1J and AG09173 parental APOE3/3 vs CRISPR APOE4/4), ACSA-1 sorted, <passage 11, 4-day serum withdrawal; 5 min Alexa-transferrin uptake at 37C, flow cytometry, normalized to APOE3.
human_check: Effect read off box medians (APOE4 ~0.5 of APOE3). p<0.0001 is printed on the figure image, not in legend text (Wilcoxon signed-rank). n = 23 flow runs per genotype (11 KOLF2.1J + 12 AG09173).

description: Immunostaining of RAB11-positive recycling endosomes showed reduced RAB11 intensity per cell area in APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes, with high variability in APOE4.
quote: Compared to APOE3 astrocytes, APOE4 astrocytes showed decreased levels of all three downstream endosomal compartment markers (RAB11, RAB7, LAMP1) indicating dysfunction throughout the endocytic pathway.
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, two isogenic APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 sets (KOLF2.1J, AG09173), 4-day serum-free culture; RAB11 immunocytochemistry, intensity per cell area (vimentin mask), normalized to APOE3.
human_check: p=0.0496 (unpaired t-test) is printed on the figure image only; borderline. Text notes this contrasts with earlier serum-containing results (ref 12), so direction may depend on culture conditions. n = 18 wells per genotype. Exact P printed on the figure panel itself (coded printed_in_text).

description: Flow cytometry showed lower EEA1 early-endosome intensity in APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes (fewer, not enlarged, early endosomes), opposite to the endosomal-swelling pattern seen in other APOE4 models.
quote: as well as decreased levels of EEA1 (early endosomal antigen 1)-positive early endosomes (Figure 2C, 2E and S2C, S2D) in APOE4 astrocytes relative to their APOE3 counterparts
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, two isogenic APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 sets (KOLF2.1J, AG09173), 4-day serum-free culture; EEA1 immunostaining quantified by flow cytometry, normalized to APOE3.
human_check: Reduced EEA1 argues against endosomal trapping of receptors in early endosomes; kept as not against (team leader, 2026-11-20): it matches the reduced transferrin uptake in this paper and the fewer Rab5/EEA1 puncta in 33027662, both coded not against, and H2 does not require early-endosome swelling. Effect read off box medians (~0.85-0.87 vs 1.0).
